title: Dover v Leicester and Salisbury v Blackpool: BBC Picks the FA Cup Stage
body:
The BBC will show two FA Cup second-round ties, Dover v Leicester and Salisbury v Blackpool [S1]. Both are the broadcaster's chosen second-round matches for next month [S1].

The hosts are non-league clubs, Dover Athletic and Salisbury, who will stage those two ties [S1]. It gives the smaller clubs a national stage they rarely get, and it reminds anyone who has forgotten that the cup still belongs to the whole pyramid.

The evidence gives no league form, recent results or predictions for either tie, so anyone pushing a confident forecast is guessing.

Here is the take: a broadcaster choosing non-league venues is a sign the competition still has teeth. The bigger name wants the cameras, the underdog wants the occasion, and the strongest sides treat both as a test rather than a formality. The side that treats it as a formality is the one most likely to get embarrassed.

Watch how the coverage frames these nights, because it shows where the attention is heading. There is more to this than the headline suggests.

The Touchline Take: one to keep an eye on, and the non-league hosts deserve top billing.

evidence.text: BBC Sport: BBC to show Dover v Leicester and Salisbury v Blackpool. Non-league clubs Dover Athletic and Salisbury will stage the BBC's two chosen FA Cup second-round ties next month.
